Description: The application is for LNT IDPL. It’s approval workflow where users submits their request in the
board proposal along with the attachments and submits to approvers. The approver will review the users
request and either forward to LS Head or rejects. The rejected proposals goes back to The approved
proposals will move to Legal & Secretarial Head, either the LS Head can close the proposal or further
move its legal and secretarial independent body. After their review the proposal can either approves or
rejects and sends that status back to LS head. Finally LS Head will close the proposal based on the status
of independent body. The dashboard serves to count the incoming task proposals to each department.
It composes of two module where first module is dedicated to Board proposal, True copy and other
services and second module is a legal workflow.
